code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    base = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    def lines(seq):
        out=[]
        for i, vals in enumerate(seq):
            counts=Counter(v for v in vals if v != base)
            if counts:
                color, n=counts.most_common(1)[0]
                if n >= 0.7*len(vals): out.append((i,color))
        return out
    rlines=lines(grid)
    clines=lines([[grid[r][c] for r in range(h)] for c in range(w)])
    sep={v for _,v in rlines+clines}
    marker=lambda v: v != base and v not in sep
    # Retain horizontal rules carrying a marker; vertical rules span the marker bounds.
    rlines=[(r,c) for r,c in rlines if any(marker(v) for v in grid[r])]
    marker_cols=[]
    for c,_ in clines:
        if any(marker(grid[r][c]) for r,_ in rlines): marker_cols.append(c)
    if not rlines or len(rlines)<2 or len(marker_cols)<2: return []
    cmin,cmax=min(marker_cols),max(marker_cols)
    clines=[(c,v) for c,v in clines if cmin<=c<=cmax]
    rs=[i for i,_ in rlines]; cs=[i for i,_ in clines]
    out=[]
    for ri in range(len(rs)-1):
        row=[]
        for ci in range(len(cs)-1):
            corners=[grid[rs[ri]][cs[ci]],grid[rs[ri]][cs[ci+1]],grid[rs[ri+1]][cs[ci]],grid[rs[ri+1]][cs[ci+1]]]
            v=corners[0]
            row.append(v if corners.count(v)==4 and marker(v) else base)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
